svg.title: Nguyen Huy — Full-Stack Developer
svg.desc: VamosHuiJia. Web and blockchain enthusiast. Building full-stack e-commerce and Web3 projects. Skills: React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Solidity, IPFS. Featured projects: Tea Shop and NFT Marketplace. Portfolio: huyngg.vercel.app.

g.text: Building full-stack e-commerce platforms and Web3 projects.
Learning System Design, DevOps, and Cloud Computing.
Powered by late-night coding and a good cup of coffee.
Premium tea e-commerce with an elegant storefront and admin dashboard.
Mint, buy, and sell digital art NFTs on the blockchain.
Build SaaS products and Web3 applications.
Contribute to open source. Keep growing as a Full-Stack Developer.
